verdict.line: You lose if you eat a Q (Decisive Strike) silence mid-all-in and get spun down by Judgment; you win if you deny his passive regen and force trades before his Q resets.

brief.thesis: Garen's only defensive tool against your engage is Q (Decisive Strike), an 8-second cooldown that breaks slows and silences your next spell — everything else he has is a stationary damage pulse. Camille's E (Hookshot) and Q (Precision Protocol) reset let her pick the exact moment to fight, and the measured 54.3% win rate over 230 games confirms the lane is structurally yours as long as you respect that one cooldown.

theirWindow.when: Q (Decisive Strike) is up and you're in melee
theirWindow.what: He can silence your next ability before all-inning, cancelling your E knockup or Q recast timing — bait it out with an auto or wait it out before committing to Hookshot.

yourWindow.when: your passive shield is active and his Q is down
yourWindow.what: Engage with E (Hookshot) into the knockup, land W (Tactical Sweep)'s outer-cone slow and heal, then walk into the empowered Q recast — he has no tool left to interrupt or disengage.

start.why: Runs in 82.7% of these games at 54.8% win rate — the extra AA damage and sustain let you trade into his melee range repeatedly, which is exactly how you deny his Perseverance regen tick.

boots.why: Picked in 78.1% of games at 55.2% win rate; flat physical damage reduction blunts his Judgment (E) spin and auto-attack trades in extended fights.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample core path (56.9% win rate, 65 games) — the on-hit and move speed let you land the Q recast bonus and stick to him through his Q speed burst.
Sustains you through prolonged trades so his passive regen never has a window to matter — you're outhealing and outsustaining him instead.
Completes the top core path; damage reduction plus the healing component keeps you ahead in the extended skirmishes this matchup produces.

situational.when: you're ahead and want a durability spike instead of Death's Dance (24.3% pick, 66.7% win rate as third item)
the game goes long and you need cooldown reduction to chain Q/E/W faster in extended fights
you need an early clear/wave-management component before finishing Ravenous Hydra
the enemy team has heavy CC or magic damage beyond Garen himself

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards you for landing the first auto in every trade window with max-health damage and healing — directly punishes Garen for standing still, and the sustain compounds your ability to keep pressuring his passive regen out (50.7% win rate, 26.1% pick).

summoners.why: Highest win rate combo at 53.8% over 63.6% of games — Ignite is critical here specifically because it removes Garen's passive regen entirely during a fight, turning close trades into clean kills.

playing.title: Poke to deny his regen
playing.detail: Land an auto or spell tick on him every few seconds pre-6; his passive only heals if he's untouched for a period, so constant low-grade pressure removes his sustain advantage entirely.

playing.title: Bait his Q before all-in
playing.detail: Decisive Strike breaks slows and silences on an 8-second cooldown. Throw out a spell or poke first to force it out, then commit your full combo once it's down.

playing.title: Use E as the opener, not the finisher
playing.detail: Hookshot needs a wall and knocks him up on landing — use it to start the fight so your W cone slow and Q recast land on a champion who can't walk away.

playing.title: Delay the Q recast in long trades
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's second cast does significantly more damage if you wait between hits — hold it for the tail end of extended skirmishes rather than firing both instantly.

playing.title: Respect his E spin range
playing.detail: Judgment hits nearby enemies at 325 range on a 13-9 second cooldown scaling with level — don't stand in it while trading passively, only enter that range when you're ready to commit.

playing.title: Play proactive, not passive
playing.detail: This is a 54.3% win rate lane over 230 games — freeze the wave against him and look for level 3-5 all-ins rather than sitting back and letting him scale for free.

playing.title: Save R for the finishing blow
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors him in place at 475 range from level 6 — hold it until Trinity Force is online so the fight is already won before you commit it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-timing and cooldown-tracking reasoning above is my own read of the kits, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to engage when Camille has her passive shield [P] active. Garen will recover if he does not receive damage for a certain period of time. Deal damage constantly to prevent him from recovering health!
